config.witcherywalls.title: Witchery Walls Config
config.witcherywalls.wall_spawn_chance.t: Chance for a village to generate town walls (0-100).
config.witcherywalls.keep_spawn_chance.t: Chance for a village to generate a town keep (0-100).
config.witcherywalls.watch_tower_spawn_c: Chance for a village to generate watch towers (0-100).
config.witcherywalls.dedup_radius.toolti: Minimum distance between village centers that get walls (40-512). Raise this in dense dimensions to reduce overlapping rings.
config.witcherywalls.structure_blacklist: Comma-separated structure IDs that never get walls, keeps, or towers. Example: minecraft:village_plains
config.witcherywalls.spawn_guards.toolti: Spawn Witchery village guards on keeps, towers, walls, and streets.
config.witcherywalls.invalid_number: Check number ranges and try again.
config.witcherywalls.invalid_structure_i: Blacklist entries must be valid structure IDs (e.g. minecraft:village_plains).
